在“字体”中选择内置字体与字形，分别调整诗句和色名的字号。女书凤栖可附带汉字原文.en: In Fonts, choose a bundled font and character style, then adjust poem and color-name sizes separately. Nüshu Fengqi can show the Chinese original alongside; characters without a matching glyph fall back to Chinese.
